editorial:
Imagine finding an email from someone who is already gone. That is exactly what happens to Mara when she opens her dead sister Leah's laptop. You get pulled right into the mystery when she finds a weird video file that sets up a deadly game with strict rules. The vibe is super creepy and makes you feel like someone is always watching from the shadows. It starts slow, but once the game begins, the tension ramps up quickly and keeps you on the edge of your seat wondering if Mara will make it out alive.

The acting is great and makes the grief feel real, which makes the scares hit harder. While some of the rules in the game feel a bit confusing at first, the big twists at the end make up for it. If you love movies that mess with your head, you need to see this.
endingExplained: You find out that the game was actually a trap to swap souls. In the final scene, Mara thinks she won, but the twist is that Leah was actually the one trying to get back into the real world. Leah successfully takes over Mara's body, leaving Mara trapped inside the laptop forever. It ends with Leah smiling at the camera, showing that the warning about staying if you lose was completely true.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and scary games.
